description: iLAO* (*improved LAO\**) solves a stochastic shortest path problem by heuristic search over the states that the greedy policy reaches from the start. It works in passes. Each pass is one depth-first walk along the greedy actions: it expands every unexpanded state it meets and backs up the states in postorder (children before parents). The run ends when a pass expands nothing, its largest change is below ε, and the solved check of LRTDP passes on the start state. The result is ε-consistent on the states the policy reaches; it is the LAO* variant to use.

papers.title: LAO*: A heuristic search algorithm that finds solutions with loops
